description: Erection of a two storey side extension and part single storey rear extension to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Fire Safety Strategy. Received on 15/06/2022; PA1-2209-01, PA1-2209-02, PA1-2209-03, PA1-2209-04, PA1-2209-05 A, PA1-2209-06, PA1-2209-07 A & PA1-2209-08 A. Received on 01/07/2022; PA1-2209-10. Received on 13/07/2022; PA1-2209-00 A. Received on 13/06/2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in any side wall of the extensions hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - No part of the development (including any guttering) shall overhang land outside of the ownership of the owner of the application property.
Condition : 6 - No front extension or porch shall be erected to the front of the building or development hereby permitted, without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
